remarks: Fabulous 1-bedroom end unit offers the perfect combination of comfort and convenience! Relax by the cozy gas fireplace in the light-filled living room featuring a charming garden window. The kitchen boasts granite counters, stainless steel appliances and gas range for the home chef. Retreat to the private bedroom with balcony and generous double closet storage. Unwind in the bathroom with jetted tub and the stackable laundry in the unit adds convenience. Enjoy the community pool and beautiful landscaping. The attached private garage and private storage room are a plus. Freshly updated with new flooring, fresh paint throughout and HVAC and hot water heater less than a year old - simply move right in! Conveniently located to the Merritt 7 train station, major roadways and shopping, this bright, move-in ready gem is ready for new owners!
